champion.name: dualtrend
champion.hypothesis: Two trend-following ledgers: USDT side buys strength and sells for USDT profit; BTC side sells weakness and buys back for BTC profit. Gains net of fees and tax; trailing floors; hard stop.

lastEvaluation.diagnosis:
Three cost signals stand out, and fee drag + trackB parking dominate over tilt mis-sizing.

1) Fee drag is large relative to realized edge. Since inception, fees=4.30 USD vs total realized profit (usdt 2.63 + btc 0.0001*80508≈8.05) = 10.68 USD → fees consume ~40% of gross realized gains. In the most recent week alone: fees=1.77 vs realized (2.63 usdt + 0.000034*80508≈2.74) = 5.37 → still ~33% fee drag, on only 4 closes/8 opens. With 0.10% fee + 0.05% slippage per side (~0.30% round trip), a lotsPerSide=8 / atrStepMult=0.7 grid is generating many small lots whose thin per-lot profit is largely offset by transaction costs.

2) TrackB parking is a real drag. In the 180d backtest, openLots.trackB=4 out of only 4 total open lots (usdtSide 3 + btcSide 1), with unrealisedUsd=-24.04 — i.e. 100% of currently open inventory is underwater track B, dragging equity down ~2.4% of capital while sitting idle. hardStop=0.422 is so loose these lots never get stopped or floor-ratcheted out; they just park. This is consistent with returnBtcPct=-5.6% (BTC stack shrank) even though returnUsdPct=+7.0% barely beat static 50/50 (+6.69%) — most of the apparent "edge" is thin and could reverse if those 4 parked lots mark further underwater.

3) Regime flip churn is measurable but secondary. In one week the gate flipped grid→moon→grid→moon→grid four times (regimeChanges), with active="grid" but candidate="moon" and daily/weekly disagreeing (agree=0) even after the Monday lock — i.e. the 5m confirmation is overriding the weekly lock faster than intended given confirmBars=48/dwell=144. Each flip forces entry/exit posture changes and likely adds to the small-trade fee drag noted in (1), though barsByRegime (grid 721 vs moon 1251) shows regime is not literally flapping every bar, just often enough to matter.

Tilt (score 0.72 vs target 0.64, endBtcShare 0.65) is within bounds and not obviously oversized — it's a minor contributor next to fees and parked trackB capital.

Net: the system barely clears the static 50/50 benchmark (7.01% vs 6.69%) while paying ~33-40% of its realized profit in fees and carrying its entire open inventory as underwater track B lots. Fee drag from over-trading and trackB parking from an overly loose hardStop/floor are the primary levers; false regime flips are a secondary amplifier of the fee problem.
hypotheses: Claim: Raising confirmBars/regimeDwellBars and adding an ADX regime gate will cut the ~4 flips/week and reduce trade count enough to lower fee drag (currently ~33-40% of realized profit) without reducing USD return below the static 50/50 benchmark.

Claim: Cutting hardStop and the trackB floor thresholds will release the 4 currently-parked trackB lots (-$24 unrealized) sooner, reducing parked/underwater capital and improving BTC-denominated equity versus the current -5.6% BTC return.
